additional_final_CI_disposition.scope: These 12 occurrences were not among the 177 nodes in the original representative local review. They are explicitly reviewed here rather than attributed to that earlier sample.
additional_final_CI_disposition.finding: Axe could not determine the background of five importance-value strong elements, naming each containing button as the obscurer. The actual CI 320/390/768/1440 screenshots were inspected: complete values remain visible and readable, including +0.4067 at the right edge. No occluded digit or contrast failure was identified.
additional_final_CI_disposition.ratio_method: WCAG sRGB relative-luminance formula applied to the unchanged authored foreground and actual white/selected-row background colors. No new computed-style browser measurement is claimed.
additional_final_CI_disposition.disposition: Manual background-boundary review accepted for these targets; no markup or color change warranted by this evidence.
